title_zh: v111 Formal Stage A 脱敏结果摘要
title_en: v111 Formal Stage A Redacted Result Summary
route_zh: 公开三维 PoolFire CFD rho -> 九视角 straight-ray 代理 -> observation/geometry-only DRC warm initializer -> 未修改 CGLS/PCGLS
route_en: Public 3D PoolFire CFD rho -> nine-view straight-ray proxy -> observation/geometry-only DRC warm initializer -> unchanged CGLS/PCGLS
headline_zh: 15 个 trajectory-seed summary 全部通过，正式 Stage A 的聚合结果由独立程序复算一致。
headline_en: All 15 trajectory-seed summaries pass, and the aggregate Formal Stage A result is independently reproduced.
interpretation_zh: 这是当前公开 PoolFire proxy 上的正式多轨迹精度证据：在冻结八项 accuracy gates 下，candidate 与冻结 controls 的结果完成了独立复算，且当前没有简单 frozen control 支配 candidate。它还不是跨数据集泛化、资源收益或真实 BOST 证据。
interpretation_en: This is formal multi-trajectory accuracy evidence on the current public PoolFire proxy: under the frozen eight accuracy gates, the candidate and frozen controls were independently recomputed, and no simple frozen control currently dominates the candidate. It is not yet evidence of cross-dataset generalization, resource advantage, or real BOST.
